Calibrated noise floor, signal-to-noise ratio, total harmonic distortion and effective bit depth have not been measured. Clipping and upsampling rules provide reviewable risk clues. Native lossless/DSD provenance, original codec bitrate and AI processing algorithms remain unverified.
Limits and interpretation

This report evaluates stored measurements with conservative rules, not a calibrated perceptual-quality model. Naturally narrow-band recordings, old masters, silence and synthetic signals can resemble processing artifacts. No authenticity percentage is computed.

Waterfall data is quantized to 8-bit levels and compressed in time/frequency. Representative buckets are not a full-precision audit of every sample. Logarithmic display adds no frequency detail, and no measured playback-device capability is inferred.
DSD is observed after PCM decoding. Ultrasonic noise shaping does not demonstrate high-resolution musical information or native DSD provenance; PCM source-clue rules are not applied.
The source and analysis sample rates differ. Source band-edge classification is suppressed because decoder resampling can change the spectrum.
